## Model 9. [DEPRECATED] Time-Varying Empirical Recruitment Distribution {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-important}

This recruitment model has been deprecated. The model for a time-varying empirical
recruitment distribution can be fully implemented using [**Empirical Recruitment Distribution Recruitment (Model 3)**](#model-3.-empirical-recruitment-distribution).

:::
